Conv.int8_theory: PRIMARY target — DP4A/IMMA INT8 conv kernels; weights per-tensor or per-channel quantized

ConvTranspose.int8_theory: Transpose-conv INT8 support is patchier; may run FP16 fallback

Add.int8_theory: Elementwise Add needs aligned input scales; residual adds are common INT8 sensitivity points

Mul.int8_theory: Elementwise Mul (used in GELU approx / up-proj); scale-mismatch sensitive

Div.int8_theory: Div in Erf/GELU softmax-ish path; division not natively INT8, usually FP16

Erf.int8_theory: Erf is transcendental (GELU); TRT fuses GELU but the Erf/Div/Mul cluster is the sensitive tail

existing_QDQ_nodes: NONE (graph is plain FP32 — implicit-quantization PTQ, no Q/DQ)
quantization_style: IMPLICIT (calibrator-based) — graph has no Q/DQ, TRT inserts quantization during build
disclaimer: op 'likely' is theoretical. Actual per-op precision is decided by the TRT builder autotuner; confirmed only via build profile / --layerOutputTypes / verbose log in Stage C1.
sensitivity_watchlist: ConvTranspose (up_1.6, output projection) — INT8 support uncertain
Erf/Div/Mul GELU tail (5 each) — transcendental, likely FP16
